CustomField.description: Calculated rebook URL the family clicks (e.g. shown on the Lead record / pasted into a follow-up email by the AC) to schedule a new IC Service Appointment after their original IC was canceled. Builds itself from IC_Reschedule_Token__c — when the token is cleared after a successful rebook, the URL becomes blank and the link stops working.
CustomField.label: IC Reschedule Link
